title: Comparing teeth
text: The yellow gear has $$14$$ teeth, the orange gear has $$28$$ teeth.

title: Comparing rotations
text: As the yellow gear rotates once, each of the $$14$$ teeth mesh with the orange gear, rotating it through $$14$$ teeth at the connection point.

title: Comparing rotations
text: A full rotation of the orange gear uses $$28$$ teeth. Thus rotating through $$14$$ teeth is $$\frac{14}{28}=\frac{1}{2}$$ of a rotation.
